blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court needed to review the doctrine that made it tougher to prove that a public official committed plunder. Sandiganbayan Presiding Justice Geraldine Faith Econg said this on Tuesday. A panel of the Judicial and Bar Council was told by Econg, who is among the candidates for a vacancy in the high tribunal, that it had been difficult for courts to convict the “main plunderer” in a case because of the so-called Arroyo doctrine. “[I] believe that rule in the Arroyo doctrine on plunder must be revisited and [reviewed] again.
